claims.text: Our model outperforms existing neural extractive models on all ROUGE scores and METEOR, showing better performance than the Baseline model and previous works.
The improvements in performance are particularly notable for longer documents, where our model's design specifically addresses challenges associated with them.
The addition of local context significantly enhances performance, indicating that our model's architecture effectively utilizes local information.
